# Login to simple_note and search for relevant Amazon shopping list notes
pw = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
print([p for p in pw if p['account_name']=='simple_note'])

simple_pw = [p['password'] for p in pw if p['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
access_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='allison-calhoun@gmail.com', password=simple_pw)['access_token']

# Search for notes with keywords likely in title
queries = ['amazon shopping list', 'Amazon shopping list', 'amazon', 'shopping list']
results_by_query = {}

for q in queries:
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    collected = []
    while True:
        page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, query=q, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        # page expected to be list-like
        if not page:
            break
        collected.extend(page)
        # if fewer than limit, assume last page
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    results_by_query[q] = collected
    print('query', q, 'found', len(collected))

# Deduplicate by note_id
seen = set(); dedup=[]
for q, items in results_by_query.items():
    for it in items:
        if it['note_id'] not in seen:
            seen.add(it['note_id'])
            dedup.append(it)

print('dedup total', len(dedup))
print([(it['note_id'], it['title'], it.get('pinned', None), it.get('updated_at', None)) for it in dedup[:20]])

# Search for each shopping list item on Amazon platform-wide
import re

def search_all_products(query, page_limit=20):
    page_index = 0
    collected = []
    while True:
        resp = apis.amazon.search_products(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not resp:
            break
        collected.extend(resp)
        # stop if last page smaller than limit
        if len(resp) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return collected

amazon_token = amazon_access_token
items = [
    (3, 'IKEA Rattan Dining Chair'),
    (2, 'Breville JE98XL Juice Fountain Plus Centrifugal Juicer'),
    (1, 'Threshold 12" Wall Clock'),
    (3, 'simplehuman 10-Liter Slim Profile Step Trash Can'),
    (2, 'Whirlpool 0.9 cu. ft. Countertop Microwave in White'),
    (1, 'Sterilite 1.75 Bushel Laundry Basket'),
    (3, 'mDesign Hotel Quality Polyester/Cotton Blend Fabric Shower Curtain'),
]

search_queries = [q for _, q in items]

all_results = {}
for q in search_queries:
    res = search_all_products(q)
    all_results[q] = res
    print('\nQUERY:', q, '->', len(res), 'results')
    # print top 5 for inspection
    for r in res[:5]:
        print({k: r.get(k) for k in ['product_id','product_type','name','price','delivery_days','inventory_quantity','color','relative_size']})
